lines.text: Two cash machines deposit into the same bank account at the same moment: fifty dollars each, into a balance of one hundred.
lines.caption: Two cash machines deposit into the same bank account at the same moment: fifty dollars each, into a balance of one hundred.

lines.text: The balance should end at two hundred.
lines.caption: The balance should end at two hundred.

lines.text: Sometimes it ends at one hundred and fifty.
lines.caption: Sometimes it ends at one hundred and fifty.

lines.text: One deposit has vanished.
lines.caption: One deposit has vanished.

lines.text: A program that does several things at once has to coordinate them.
lines.caption: A program that does several things at once has to coordinate them.

lines.text: There are two broad families of ways to do it; there are others, but these are the two you'll meet most.
lines.caption: There are two broad families of ways to do it; there are others, but these are the two you'll meet most.

lines.text: In one, threads share memory, and take turns with locks.
lines.caption: In one, threads share memory, and take turns with locks.

lines.text: In the other, nothing is shared, at least in the code you write: parts of the program pass messages instead.
lines.caption: In the other, nothing is shared, at least in the code you write: parts of the program pass messages instead.

lines.text: Go's documentation puts it as a slogan: "Do not communicate by sharing memory; instead, share memory by communicating."
lines.caption: Go's documentation puts it as a slogan: "Do not communicate by sharing memory; instead, share memory by communicating."

lines.text: The hope is that if nothing is shared, bugs like the vanishing deposit can't happen.
lines.caption: The hope is that if nothing is shared, bugs like the vanishing deposit can't happen.

lines.text: So does passing messages make them go away?
lines.caption: So does passing messages make them go away?

lines.text: Here is how a deposit vanishes.
lines.caption: Here is how a deposit vanishes.

lines.text: A deposit takes three steps: read the balance, add fifty, write the result back.
lines.caption: A deposit takes three steps: read the balance, add fifty, write the result back.

lines.text: Machine A reads one hundred.
lines.caption: Machine A reads one hundred.

lines.text: Before A writes, machine B also reads one hundred.
lines.caption: Before A writes, machine B also reads one hundred.

lines.text: A writes one hundred and fifty.
lines.caption: A writes one hundred and fifty.

lines.text: Then B writes one hundred and fifty, over A's result.
lines.caption: Then B writes one hundred and fifty, over A's result.

lines.text: A's deposit is gone.
lines.caption: A's deposit is gone.

lines.text: This is called a lost update.
lines.caption: This is called a lost update.

lines.text: Only two orders of the six steps are safe: one machine's whole deposit finishes before the other's starts.
lines.caption: Only two orders of the six steps are safe: one machine's whole deposit finishes before the other's starts.

lines.text: In any other order, a deposit is lost.
lines.caption: In any other order, a deposit is lost.

lines.text: Usually the two deposits don't overlap at all, so the bug shows up only now and then.
lines.caption: Usually the two deposits don't overlap at all, so the bug shows up only now and then.

lines.text: A bug whose result depends on the timing of concurrent steps is called a race condition.
lines.caption: A bug whose result depends on the timing of concurrent steps is called a race condition.

lines.text: This bug is also what's called a data race.
lines.caption: This bug is also what's called a data race.

lines.text: Two threads use the same memory.
lines.caption: Two threads use the same memory.

lines.text: At least one of them writes.
lines.caption: At least one of them writes.

lines.text: And nothing forces an order between them.
lines.caption: And nothing forces an order between them.

lines.text: The two names describe different things.
lines.caption: The two names describe different things.

lines.text: "Race condition" is about the result.
lines.caption: "Race condition" is about the result.

lines.text: "Data race" is about how the memory is used.
lines.caption: "Data race" is about how the memory is used.

lines.text: Here, both apply.
lines.caption: Here, both apply.

lines.text: A lost update is the mild outcome.
lines.caption: A lost update is the mild outcome.

lines.text: For a program with a data race, C and C plus plus promise nothing at all, not even that a read returns a value some thread actually wrote.
lines.caption: For a program with a data race, C and C++ promise nothing at all, not even that a read returns a value some thread actually wrote.

lines.text: And when the steps do overlap often, it isn't rare.
lines.caption: And when the steps do overlap often, it isn't rare.

lines.text: In a small C program, two threads each add one to a shared counter ten million times, so it should end at twenty million.
lines.caption: In a small C program, two threads each add one to a shared counter ten million times, so it should end at twenty million.

lines.text: In five runs on this machine, it ended between about ten point one and eleven point seven million, a different number each time.
lines.caption: In five runs on this machine, it ended between about ten point one and eleven point seven million, a different number each time.

lines.text: The shared-memory fix is a lock.
lines.caption: The shared-memory fix is a lock.

lines.text: A thread takes the lock before it reads the balance, and releases it after it writes.
lines.caption: A thread takes the lock before it reads the balance, and releases it after it writes.

lines.text: While one thread holds the lock, any other thread that wants it waits.
lines.caption: While one thread holds the lock, any other thread that wants it waits.

lines.text: So the three steps happen as one, with nothing in between.
lines.caption: So the three steps happen as one, with nothing in between.

lines.text: With a lock around it, the counter reaches twenty million on every run.
lines.caption: With a lock around it, the counter reaches twenty million on every run.

lines.text: But a lock only protects code that takes it.
lines.caption: But a lock only protects code that takes it.

lines.text: Nothing stops one forgotten code path from touching the balance without it, and then the race is back.
lines.caption: Nothing stops one forgotten code path from touching the balance without it, and then the race is back.

lines.text: Locks also bring a new failure.
lines.caption: Locks also bring a new failure.

lines.text: A transfer from account A to account B has to lock both accounts.
lines.caption: A transfer from account A to account B has to lock both accounts.

lines.text: Say each transfer locks the paying account first, then the receiving account.
lines.caption: Say each transfer locks the paying account first, then the receiving account.

lines.text: One thread transfers from A to B.
lines.caption: One thread transfers from A to B.

lines.text: It locks A, then waits for B.
lines.caption: It locks A, then waits for B.

lines.text: At the same moment, another thread transfers from B to A.
lines.caption: At the same moment, another thread transfers from B to A.

lines.text: It locks B, then waits for A.
lines.caption: It locks B, then waits for A.

lines.text: Each is waiting for a lock the other holds, and neither will let go.
lines.caption: Each is waiting for a lock the other holds, and neither will let go.

lines.text: That's a deadlock.
lines.caption: That's a deadlock.

lines.text: The standard fix is to take locks in one fixed order everywhere, say, the lower account number first.
lines.caption: The standard fix is to take locks in one fixed order everywhere, say, the lower account number first.

lines.text: Then a cycle of waiting can't form.
lines.caption: Then a cycle of waiting can't form.

lines.text: Running both transfers at once, a thousand times: the first version got stuck almost every time, the fixed order never.
lines.caption: Running both transfers at once, a thousand times: the first version got stuck almost every time, the fixed order never.

lines.text: But every piece of code that takes these locks has to follow that order, including code someone else wrote.
lines.caption: But every piece of code that takes these locks has to follow that order, including code someone else wrote.

lines.text: A lock can be forgotten because every thread can still reach the balance.
lines.caption: A lock can be forgotten because every thread can still reach the balance.

lines.text: What if nothing else could reach it at all?
lines.caption: What if nothing else could reach it at all?

lines.text: Then there would be no lock to forget.
lines.caption: Then there would be no lock to forget.

lines.text: That's where message passing starts.
lines.caption: That's where message passing starts.

lines.text: Give the balance a single owner, and let nothing else touch it.
lines.caption: Give the balance a single owner, and let nothing else touch it.

lines.text: In the actor model, that owner is an actor: a part of the program with its own private state, and a mailbox.
lines.caption: In the actor model, that owner is an actor: a part of the program with its own private state, and a mailbox.

lines.text: The cash machines never read the balance.
lines.caption: The cash machines never read the balance.

lines.text: They send the actor a message, "deposit fifty", and it goes into the mailbox.
lines.caption: They send the actor a message, "deposit fifty", and it goes into the mailbox.

lines.text: The actor takes one message at a time, and finishes it before starting the next.
lines.caption: The actor takes one message at a time, and finishes it before starting the next.

lines.text: So the two deposits can't interleave.
lines.caption: So the two deposits can't interleave.

lines.text: The actor adds the first fifty, then the second, and the balance ends at two hundred.
lines.caption: The actor adds the first fifty, then the second, and the balance ends at two hundred.

lines.text: There's no lock, and no data race on the balance, because only the actor ever touches it.
lines.caption: There's no lock, and no data race on the balance, because only the actor ever touches it.

lines.text: Sending doesn't wait: a machine drops its message in the mailbox and carries on.
lines.caption: Sending doesn't wait: a machine drops its message in the mailbox and carries on.

lines.text: How firmly "nothing else" holds depends on the system.
lines.caption: How firmly "nothing else" holds depends on the system.

lines.text: In Erlang, processes don't share memory by default.
lines.caption: In Erlang, processes don't share memory by default.

lines.text: A message is copied to the receiver.
lines.caption: A message is copied to the receiver.

lines.text: Shared tables exist, but a process has to opt in.
lines.caption: Shared tables exist, but a process has to opt in.

lines.text: In Akka, a toolkit for Java and Scala, keeping an actor's state private is up to the programmer.
lines.caption: In Akka, a toolkit for Java and Scala, keeping an actor's state private is up to the programmer.

lines.text: But because an actor's send doesn't wait, a cash machine never learns when its request was taken.
lines.caption: But because an actor's send doesn't wait, a cash machine never learns when its request was taken.

lines.text: The mailbox has the deposit.
lines.caption: The mailbox has the deposit.

lines.text: Has the actor applied it yet, or is it still in the queue?
lines.caption: Has the actor applied it yet, or is it still in the queue?

lines.text: The machine can't tell.
lines.caption: The machine can't tell.

lines.text: The other message-passing family is built the opposite way: a send waits for a receiver.
lines.caption: The other message-passing family is built the opposite way: a send waits for a receiver.

lines.text: It comes from Tony Hoare's communicating sequential processes, or C S P, and Go's channels come out of this tradition.
lines.caption: It comes from Tony Hoare's communicating sequential processes, or CSP, and Go's channels come out of this tradition.

lines.text: Processes share nothing, and talk over channels.
lines.caption: Processes share nothing, and talk over channels.

lines.text: A channel is a connection that processes send values into and receive them from.
lines.caption: A channel is a connection that processes send values into and receive them from.

lines.text: A Go channel made without a buffer, which is the default, makes a send wait until a receiver takes the value.
lines.caption: A Go channel made without a buffer, which is the default, makes a send wait until a receiver takes the value.

lines.text: So when a send finishes, the sender knows its value was taken.
lines.caption: So when a send finishes, the sender knows its value was taken.

lines.text: The account becomes a process that owns the balance, and receives deposits from a channel, one at a time.
lines.caption: The account becomes a process that owns the balance, and receives deposits from a channel, one at a time.

lines.text: Again, no data race on the balance.
lines.caption: Again, no data race on the balance.

lines.text: Go also lets its go routines, its lightweight threads, share memory.
lines.caption: Go also lets its goroutines, its lightweight threads, share memory.

lines.text: So in Go, one owner is a habit the programmer keeps, as in Akka.
lines.caption: So in Go, one owner is a habit the programmer keeps, as in Akka.

lines.text: Actors and channels differ in the plumbing.
lines.caption: Actors and channels differ in the plumbing.

lines.text: An actor has an address and a mailbox, and sending doesn't wait.
lines.caption: An actor has an address and a mailbox, and sending doesn't wait.

lines.text: A channel is its own object, passed around between processes, and by default a send waits for the receiver.
lines.caption: A channel is its own object, passed around between processes, and by default a send waits for the receiver.

lines.text: So it looks like the slogan wins: give each piece of state one owner, and the vanishing deposit can't happen.
lines.caption: So it looks like the slogan wins: give each piece of state one owner, and the vanishing deposit can't happen.

lines.text: For deposits, that's true.
lines.caption: For deposits, that's true.

lines.text: Now try withdrawals.
lines.caption: Now try withdrawals.

lines.text: A machine should only pay out if there's enough money.
lines.caption: A machine should only pay out if there's enough money.

lines.text: With messages, that takes two: first "what's the balance?", then "withdraw one hundred".
lines.caption: With messages, that takes two: first "what's the balance?", then "withdraw one hundred".

lines.text: The balance is one hundred.
lines.caption: The balance is one hundred.

lines.text: Machine A asks, and hears one hundred.
lines.caption: Machine A asks, and hears one hundred.

lines.text: Machine B asks, and also hears one hundred.
lines.caption: Machine B asks, and also hears one hundred.

lines.text: Both send "withdraw one hundred".
lines.caption: Both send "withdraw one hundred".

lines.text: The account handles them one at a time, just as promised, and the balance ends at minus one hundred.
lines.caption: The account handles them one at a time, just as promised, and the balance ends at minus one hundred.

lines.text: There's no data race here: only the account ever touched the balance.
lines.caption: There's no data race here: only the account ever touched the balance.

lines.text: But the result still depended on timing.
lines.caption: But the result still depended on timing.

lines.text: It's a race condition, between messages instead of between memory steps.
lines.caption: It's a race condition, between messages instead of between memory steps.

lines.text: In a test of a hundred thousand runs, the account was overdrawn in about seventeen hundred.
lines.caption: In a test of a hundred thousand runs, the account was overdrawn in about seventeen hundred.

lines.text: The fix is to make the check and the withdrawal one message: "withdraw one hundred if the balance allows it".
lines.caption: The fix is to make the check and the withdrawal one message: "withdraw one hundred if the balance allows it".

lines.text: The owner does both in one step.
lines.caption: The owner does both in one step.

lines.text: In the same test, the account was never overdrawn.
lines.caption: In the same test, the account was never overdrawn.

lines.text: Locks raised the same question: which steps have to happen as one?
lines.caption: Locks raised the same question: which steps have to happen as one?

lines.text: Messages don't answer it for you.
lines.caption: Messages don't answer it for you.

lines.text: Messages can deadlock too.
lines.caption: Messages can deadlock too.

lines.text: Make each account its own process, with a channel.
lines.caption: Make each account its own process, with a channel.

lines.text: To transfer, an account sends "credit thirty" to the other account, and waits until the other account takes it.
lines.caption: To transfer, an account sends "credit thirty" to the other account, and waits until the other account takes it.

lines.text: Start a transfer from A to B, and one from B to A, at the same moment.
lines.caption: Start a transfer from A to B, and one from B to A, at the same moment.

lines.text: A is waiting for B to take its message.
lines.caption: A is waiting for B to take its message.

lines.text: B is waiting for A to take its message.
lines.caption: B is waiting for A to take its message.

lines.text: Neither is listening, because each is stuck in its own send.
lines.caption: Neither is listening, because each is stuck in its own send.

lines.text: It's the lock deadlock again: a cycle of waiting, without a single lock.
lines.caption: It's the lock deadlock again: a cycle of waiting, without a single lock.

lines.text: In a thousand runs, both accounts got stuck in about half.
lines.caption: In a thousand runs, both accounts got stuck in about half.

lines.text: The fix follows the same rule as for locks: break the cycle.
lines.caption: The fix follows the same rule as for locks: break the cycle.

lines.text: Here, the account hands the send to a helper, a separate goroutine that waits in its place.
lines.caption: Here, the account hands the send to a helper, a separate goroutine that waits in its place.

lines.text: The account itself keeps listening, instead of waiting in the middle of a transfer.
lines.caption: The account itself keeps listening, instead of waiting in the middle of a transfer.

lines.text: Now nothing inside the account is ever stuck in a send.
lines.caption: Now nothing inside the account is ever stuck in a send.

lines.text: In the same test, nothing got stuck.
lines.caption: In the same test, nothing got stuck.

lines.text: Sending to an actor never waits.
lines.caption: Sending to an actor never waits.

lines.text: But often an actor needs an answer, not just delivery.
lines.caption: But often an actor needs an answer, not just delivery.

lines.text: It sends a request, and then won't handle anything else until the reply lands in its mailbox.
lines.caption: It sends a request, and then won't handle anything else until the reply lands in its mailbox.

lines.text: If two actors do that to each other at the same moment, each waits on the other forever.
lines.caption: If two actors do that to each other at the same moment, each waits on the other forever.

lines.text: Real code shows the same pattern.
lines.caption: Real code shows the same pattern.

lines.text: A study of real concurrency bugs in six widely used Go projects sorted them two ways.
lines.caption: A study of real concurrency bugs in six widely used Go projects sorted them two ways.

lines.text: Among the bugs that gave wrong results, message passing caused only about one in five.
lines.caption: Among the bugs that gave wrong results, message passing caused only about one in five.

lines.text: But among the bugs where code hung, it caused more than half.
lines.caption: But among the bugs where code hung, it caused more than half.

lines.text: So does passing messages make the vanishing deposit go away?
lines.caption: So does passing messages make the vanishing deposit go away?

lines.text: Yes.
lines.caption: Yes.

lines.text: Give the balance one owner, and that bug can't happen.
lines.caption: Give the balance one owner, and that bug can't happen.

lines.text: But its cousins remain: a check and an action split across two messages, and processes waiting on each other in a circle.
lines.caption: But its cousins remain: a check and an action split across two messages, and processes waiting on each other in a circle.

lines.text: So one owner per piece of state rules out data races on it: by the structure of the program, not by everyone remembering a lock.
lines.caption: So one owner per piece of state rules out data races on it: by the structure of the program, not by everyone remembering a lock.

lines.text: That holds wherever the language enforces the ownership.
lines.caption: That holds wherever the language enforces the ownership.

lines.text: It's a real gain, and it's why the slogan exists.
lines.caption: It's a real gain, and it's why the slogan exists.

lines.text: Two decisions are left in each of these models.
lines.caption: Two decisions are left in each of these models.

lines.text: You still choose which steps must happen as one: what a lock covers, or what one message does.
lines.caption: You still choose which steps must happen as one: what a lock covers, or what one message does.

lines.text: And you still have to keep waits from forming a cycle.
lines.caption: And you still have to keep waits from forming a cycle.

lines.text: So neither model is simply the safe one.
lines.caption: So neither model is simply the safe one.

lines.text: They differ in what each makes easy, and what each makes easy to forget.
lines.caption: They differ in what each makes easy, and what each makes easy to forget.

lines.text: Even the Go documentation that gives the slogan adds that it can be taken too far.
lines.caption: Even the Go documentation that gives the slogan adds that it can be taken too far.

lines.text: Go's advice is to use whichever is most expressive, or simplest, for the job: channels to hand work or data from one part of a program to another, and a lock to guard a piece of shared state.
lines.caption: Go's advice is to use whichever is most expressive, or simplest, for the job: channels to hand work or data from one part of a program to another, and a lock to guard a piece of shared state.
